baseline.method: Actual api_history serialization of six statuses × absent/stored/sent receipt, then independently evaluated exact old HEAD and candidate history rendering.
baseline.observed: Old sent orders with both receipt variants suppress transaction explanation; stored receipts on five nonpending statuses promise a future receipt update. Candidate removes both inconsistencies and preserves pending safety advice.

acceptanceResults: Receipt evidence depends on the actual order lifecycle. Pending sent receipt retains current review/duplicate-payment warning; pending stored receipt says review status is not confirmed and warns against duplicate payment.

Paid, sent, expired, failed and cancelled receipt evidence uses only historical receipt/file facts. No claim of receipt verification, delivered funds or refund is introduced, and no future receipt update is promised.

Every sent order with an available backend transaction URL has a separate transaction explanation whether a receipt is absent, stored or sent. It directs the user to check confirmations in the explorer and correctly locates the existing transaction action below.

Sent without tx_url does not invent a transaction action or explanation. Paid and terminal states retain their current status, warning/support and no-pay action policy. Delayed paid keeps its existing warning.

Real Chrome refresh GETs render the full receipt/status matrix at 320,390,1280px; selected filters remove old evidence, restore current evidence and preserve usable keyboard support. Existing request ownership/deadline/copy/payment guard checks still pass.

The inspected 320px cards show readable receipt and transaction facts, wrapped lines within card bounds, the transaction action below its explanation and support available on pending/completed/cancelled cards.

verification.baselineFocusedResult: 23 failing candidate-behavior cases on old HTML as recorded by primary

verification.preflight: Original deployed HTML returned GET200/POST405 and exact rendered-template match; active Relay/bot/Nginx identities recorded before replacement.
verification.rollback: Disposable fsynced atomic OLD to NEW to exact OLD rehearsal passed; cleanup verified.

nextPrerequisite.item: E4 / ACTIVITY_PAYMENT_SESSION_STATE / expose closed payment-session state truthfully in activity
nextPrerequisite.observed: Exact existing SQLite read methods over an in-memory synthetic ledger produce a pending order whose latest payment session is failed. Existing _session_dead returns true. api_history excludes its token and omits session state; exact history render still labels it waiting for payment with no closed-session advice. Payment action is correctly absent and support remains available.
nextPrerequisite.disposition: Exactly one separate canonical E4 read-only status-contract prerequisite; no backend/session-state implementation in this slice.

limitations: Backend fixtures and browser responses are synthetic; no real customer incidence or human comprehension was measured.
Actual-browser acceptance covers isolated Chrome. Real Telegram/iOS/WebKit, assistive screen readers and live provider confirmation remain unverified.
Receipt metadata is a persisted historical fact. This change does not establish that a receipt was approved, funds reached a recipient or a transaction was confirmed.
The next prerequisite does not infer that a failed payment session means the order failed, or that missing metadata alone means a provider session closed.
PASS covers this bounded reversible public HTML change. Production replacement/runtime verification remains primary-agent work; E4 and earlier gates remain open.
